== (1) WHAT WAS BUILT ==

`managent assign <id> [--model <name>] [--exclude <tokens>] [--dry-run] [--json]` in src/managent/main.zig. Filter: canonical_models (T317 single source, no second list) → family appetite (measurement-methodology.md §1 mirror: ollama-cloud OFF, claude-fable RESERVED, local PROBE, claude/deepseek SPEND) → row exclusions (bundle `exclude=` key read by readBundleExclusions + `--exclude` flag; each token a family name or canonical model). Draw: OsEntropy wrapping std.Io.randomSecure — a fresh getrandom/arc4random syscall per fill, no stored state, no caller-chosen seed; EntropyUnavailable is a @panic, never a silent PRNG fallback. Record: candidates / method / assign_reasons / outcome→model with model_source="assign:<method>". `assign` is in mutating_verbs (so MANAGENT_TEST=1 refuses it on the live store). stdout=data (parseable `method=…/model=…/candidates=…/reasons=…` or one JSON object), stderr=diagnostics.

== (4) DESIGN DECISIONS ==

- The appetite mirror (model_families + family_appetite) is a second copy of §1's table and MUST move in step with it; the completeness test refuses any canonical model missing a family/appetite row (F7 divergence guard) rather than silently drawing it. §1 is the authority.
- The outcome reuses `model` (not a new `assign_model` field) with `model_source="assign:<method>"` — T544 established model_source provenance; assign: random|forced|preferred is a third provenance alongside null (first-hand) and conflict:<old>-><new> (backfill). A later first-hand write (claim --agent / done / dispatch / agent) supersedes model with model_source=null; candidates/method/assign_reasons persist either way, so the ruling-33 partition survives the lifecycle.
- `preferred`/`forced` stay available by design (ruling 33): a row that genuinely needs one model names it (--model) and the reason is recorded as "preferred by row (outside qualified list)" when that model is outside the qualified set (e.g. fable RESERVED).
- harness-fits-scope is NOT a separate mechanized constraint: it depends on runtime harness state (Claude 5h remaining window, measured-suite-in-flight for local) that a static assignment function cannot see. It is expressed through the row-declared exclusion mechanism (bundle exclude= or --exclude), which is the brief's own "explicit exclusion the row declares" channel.

== (5) LIMITS / NOT FIXED ==

- docs/infra/managent/spec.md still says 'Eighteen commands' and does not document `assign` (nor several earlier verbs: tell/inbox/assert/retire/duty/reap/suggest/landmark/ping). Pre-existing drift, out of scope — spec.md is not in this row's deliverables; a doc-sync task or a later edit owns it.
- The assignment writes `model` (the choice) but does NOT dispatch or claim; the chosen model must still be dispatched/claimed through the existing path. No integration with `next`/`suggest` (they keep their own pick logic) — assignment is the recorded-pick surface, not a re-plumbing of claim.
- bundleAbsFor ownership is mixed (owned join vs borrowed absolute bundle); cmdAssign does not free it — a minor leak in a short-lived CLI process, deliberately not freed to avoid a double-free on the borrowed path.
